st: Top of the South; Te Ta
d: Uncovering a land of opposites atop New Zealand's South Island, where one of the world's longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

New Zealand's dark fjords harbor creatures normally found in the deep; as winter approaches, bottlenose dolphins must escape their freezing fjord, while in a mountain river, a longfin eel heeds the call of the sea.

Welcome to India - a land of exotic animals and exotic warfare; monkeys stage dusty dust-ups, blackbucks wage open war on the open plains, and peacock dandies swing switchblades: these are colorful battles worthy of a vibrant land.

d: Part 2/2. In central Australia, Brolga, the world's most famous kangaroo mum, learns what it takes to look after his extended animal family; the three emu chicks begin to wreak havoc and the camels are rapidly outgrowing their backyard enclosure.
